criteria.reason: The client formula applies a single ×2 multiplier when either flag is enabled, including when both are true.
With either flag alone, the formula doubles the resulting weight × reps value.
The client render-time calculation is fixed, but the attempt also changes server tonnage calculations.
No database columns or migrations were added.
The harness reports all 197 server and 289 client tests passing.
A both-flags assertion was added, though it tests a duplicated helper formula rather than the application calculation.
